beats.say: What if the entire internet turned off… right now?
Over five billion people lose connection in the same second.
No messages. No maps. No videos.
Card machines stop working, so nobody can pay.
ATMs go dark. Banks lock their doors.
Traffic lights glitch, and the whole city jams.
Most supermarkets only keep a few days of food on the shelves.
People start trading phones for bottles of water.
And nobody knows what's happening… because there's no internet to tell them.
Would you survive one week offline?
